title_zh: 约好由医生解释完整检验报告

scenario.label_zh: 了解检验结果与后续诊断安排
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清检验备注并非确诊，并约定当天与医生讨论完整报告

context_zh: 虚构诊所中，患者向接待护士询问检验报告上的备注。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Mara
sentences.text: The report mentions a possible iron deficiency. Is that my diagnosis?

sentences.speaker: Nurse Bell
sentences.text: Not yet. That note needs to be considered alongside the rest of your results.

sentences.speaker: Mara
sentences.text: Could you diagnose the problem from this page?

sentences.speaker: Nurse Bell
sentences.text: No. The doctor needs to review the full report and talk to you. I can arrange a call for this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Mara
sentences.text: Yes, please. Could the doctor explain what the note means before we discuss treatment?

sentences.speaker: Nurse Bell
sentences.text: Certainly. I have booked the call and added that question.
